# Benefits Planner: Retirement | Benefits For Your Spouse | Social Security Administration

### Benefits For Your Spouse

Even if you have never worked under Social Security, you may be able to get spouse s retirement benefits if you are at least 62 years of age and your spouse is receiving retirement or disability benefits. You can also qualify for Medicare at age 65.

If you are divorced, you may still be able to get benefits on your ex-spouse's record. For information on the requirements for Divorced Spouse's Benefits, read "If You Are Divorced

You can receive the spouse's benefit no matter what your age is if you are caring for their child who is also receiving benefits.

### How Much Will I Receive?

If you qualify and apply for your own retirement benefits and for benefits as a spouse, we always pay your own benefits first. If your benefits as a spouse are higher than your own retirement benefits, you will get a combination of benefits equaling the higher spouse benefit.

Your benefits as a spouse do not include any delayed retirement credits your spouse may receive.

If you begin receiving benefits:

- between age 62 and your full retirement age, the amount will be permanently reduced by a percentage based on the number of months up to your full retirement age.

 

- If you are under full retirement age and you continue to work while receiving benefits, your benefits may be affected by the retirement earnings test.

- at your full retirement age, your benefit as a spouse cannot exceed one-half of your spouse's full retirement amount.

 

- If you were born before January 2, 1954 and have already reached full retirement age, you can choose to receive only the spouse s benefit and delay receiving your retirement benefit until a later date. If your spouse is full retirement age and applying for spouse s benefits only, they can apply online by using the retirement application. Your spouse can also contact us to schedule an appointment.

If your spouse s birthday is January 2, 1954 or later, the option to take only one benefit at full retirement age no longer exists. If your spouse files for one benefit, they will be effectively filing for all retirement or spousal benefits.

If you will receive a pension for work not covered by Social Security such as government employment, the amount of your Social Security benefits on your spouse's record may be reduced.

Benefits paid to you as a spouse will not decrease your spouse s retirement benefit. In fact, the value of the benefits you may receive, added to their benefits, may help your spouse decide if taking benefits sooner may be more advantageous.

#### Maximum Family Benefits

If one of your spouse's children also qualifies for benefits, there is a limit to the amount we can pay family members.

The total depends on your spouse's benefit amount and the number of family members who also qualify on the same record. The total varies, but generally the total amount the worker (your spouse) and their family members can receive is about 150 to 180 percent of the worker's full retirement benefit.

If there is an ex-spouse who also qualifies for benefits, they will not affect the total amount of benefits you or your family may receive.

### How Do I Apply?

You can apply:

- Online - Use our Social Security Retirement/Medicare Benefit Application to apply for retirement, spouse's, divorced spouse's or Medicare benefits.

 

- If your spouse is already receiving benefits when you apply, or if you and your spouse apply at the same time, we will also check your eligibility for benefits as a spouse. If you qualify, your application will automatically serve as a request for spousal benefits.

- By phone - Call us at 1-800-772-1213. If you are deaf or hard of hearing, you can call us at TTY 1-800-325-0778.

 

- In person - Visit your local Social Security office. (Call first to make an appointment.)

- If you do not live in the U.S. or one of its territories you can also - Contact the nearest U.S. Social Security office, U.S. Embassy or consulate.

### Next Steps

Even if you do not qualify for benefits on someone else's record, some members of your family may qualify for benefits on your record. If you:

- are interested in information about benefits for your family, go to "Benefits For Your Family."

- never married or had children, go to "How You Apply For Retirement Benefits Or Medicare."

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Benefits Planner: Disability | How You Qualify | Social Security Administration#1_0::c0015
retrieval_contexts.text:
[Benefits Planner: Disability | How You Qualify | Social Security Administration > Benefits Planner: Disability \| How You Qualify > What happens if the adult child gets married?]
If he or she receives benefits as an adult disabled since childhood, the benefits generally end if he or she gets married. However, some marriages (for example, to another adult disabled child) are considered protected.

The rules vary depending on the situation. Contact a Social Security representative at **1-800-772-1213** (If you are deaf or hard of hearing, call TTY number at **1-800-325-0778**) to find out if the benefits can continue.

At this time, you cannot apply for disabled adult child's benefits online. If you wish to file for benefits, contact Social Security immediately at 1-800-772-1213 to request an appointment. (If you are deaf or hard of hearing, call our TTY number at 1-800-325-0778.) If you delay, some potential benefits could be lost.

If they are disabled, they can speed up the application process if they complete an Adult Disability Report and have it available at the time of their appointment.

retrieval_contexts.text:
# Benefits Planner: Survivors | How You Apply | Social Security Administration

We should be notified immediately when a person dies. However, you cannot report a death or apply for survivors benefits online.

In most cases, the funeral home will report the person s death to us. You should give the funeral home the deceased person s Social Security number if you want them to make the report.

If you need to report a death or apply for benefits, call 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778). You can speak to a Social Security representative between 7 a.m. and 7 p.m. Monday through Friday. You can also visit your local Social Security office. An appointment is not required, but if you call ahead and schedule one, it may reduce the time you spend waiting to speak to someone.

### When You Report a Death

- If you are getting benefits on your spouse's or parent's record:
  - You generally will not need to file an application for survivors benefits.
  - We'll automatically change any monthly benefits you receive to survivors benefits after we receive the report of death.
  - We may be able to pay the Special Lump-Sum Death Payment automatically.
- If you are getting retirement or disability benefits on your own record:
  - You will need to apply for the survivors benefits.
  - We will check to see whether you can get a higher benefit as a widow or widower.
- If you are not getting benefits, you should apply for survivors benefits promptly because, in some cases, benefits may not be retroactive.

### Documents Needed to Apply

Please select the benefit you will be applying for from the list below to see what information and documents you may need when you apply:

- Widows/Widowers or Surviving Divorced Spouse's Benefits
- Child's Benefits
- Mother's or Father's Benefits (You must have a child under age 16 or disabled in your care.)
- Lump-Sum Death Payment
- Parent's Benefits (You must have been dependent on your child at the time of his or her death.)

If you don't have all the documents you need, don't delay applying for Social Security.

In many cases, your local Social Security office can contact your state Bureau of Vital Statistics and verify your information online at no cost to you. If we can't verify your information online, we can still help you get the information you need.

retrieval_contexts.text:
[Benefits Planner: Survivors | If You Are The Survivor | Social Security Administration > Are other family members eligible? > A few other situations:]
- If you already receive benefits as a spouse, your benefit will automatically convert to survivors benefits after we receive the report of death.
- If you are also eligible for retirement benefits (but haven't applied yet), you have an additional option. You can apply for retirement or survivors benefits now and switch to the other (higher) benefit at a later date.
- For those already receiving retirement benefits, you can only apply for benefits as a widow or widower if the retirement benefit you receive is less than the benefits you would receive as a survivor.
  If you became entitled to retirement benefits less than 12 months ago, you may be able to withdraw your retirement application and apply for survivors benefits only. If you do that, you can reapply for the retirement benefits at a later date when they will be higher.

response.answer: 如果您需要撤回（取消）已请求的委员会听证会，您可以写信给委员会撤回您的听证会请求。这不会加快您的上诉进度，除非您同时切换到直接审查上诉选项，而该选项只能在特定时间进行。如果您切换到不同的上诉选项，您将保留相同的案卷日期，您的上诉将与具有相同日期的其他上诉同时裁决。您或您的代表应在听证会至少2周前发送书面请求，并包含您的姓名、您的上诉的VA档案编号，以及您撤回上诉的原因。您仍然可以选择提交新证据，只要您在撤回听证会请求后90天内将其发送至委员会。请使用下方列出的地址或传真号码将您的书面请求发送至委员会。

[如果我重新安排听证会，会失去排队位置吗?]
您不会失去排队位置。退伍军人上诉委员会按案卷顺序(即收到请求的顺序)安排听证会。您将保留相同的案逢日期，您的听证会将重新安排到尽可能最早的日期。

## 如果我需要撤回听证会怎么办?

如果您改变主意不想举行听证会，您可以写信给委员会撤回(取消)您的听证会请求。这不会加快您的上诉进度，除非您同时切换到直接审查上诉选项，而该选项只能在特定时间进行。如果您切换到不同的上诉选项，您将保留相同的案卷日期，您的上诉将与具有相同日期的其他上诉同时裁决。但是，每个案什获得裁决所需的时间不同。如果您需要撤回听证会请求，您或您的代表应在听证会至少2周前发送书面请求。请包盒您的姓名、您的上诉的VA档案编号，以及您撤回上诉的原因。您仍然可以选择提交新证据，只要您在撤回听证会请求后90天内将其发送至委员会。请使用下方列出的地址或传真号码将您的书面请求发送至委员会。

## 我应该将书面请求或新证据发送至委员会的哪个地址?

您可以通过邮寄或传真发送书面请求，以重新安排或撤回您的委员会听证会。您也可以在听证会之日起90天内提交新证据供法官审核。

# Request a Board Appeal | Veterans Affairs

# Request a Board Appeal

选择此选项时，您将向位于华盛顿特区的Veterans' Appeals委员会的Veterans Law Judge提出上诉。熟悉Veterans法律的法官将审查您的案件。

您可以选择添加法官将审查的新证据。

您也可以选择请求与法官举行听证会，可以在华盛顿特区亲自出席，或通过视频会议在您附近的VA地点进行。

### 我可以请求Board Appeal吗？

在初始索赔、Supplemental Claim或Higher-Level Review决定之后，您可以请求Board Appeal。您不能连续请求两次Board Appeal。

## 我可以添加新证据吗？

您可以选择添加新证据供法官审查。您需要在VA收到您的Board Appeal表格之日起90天内提交此证据。

此选项将花费更长时间。

## 我可以请求听证会吗？

您可以选择请求与法官举行听证会。视频会议听证会将在您附近的VA地点进行。

此选项将花费更长时间。

## 听证会上会发生什么？

您和法官将进行对话。法官将听取您的证词，并可能问您几个问题。如果您有代表，您的代表可以在听证会上帮助您。

听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉文件中。您可以在听证会后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

## 如何请求Board Appeal？

要请求Board Appeal，请填写Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载VA Form 10182 (PDF)

1.  ### 从3个选项中选择1个，向 Veterans Law Judge 提出上诉

Direct Review 如果你希望 Veterans Law Judge 尽快审查你的案件，请选择 Direct Review。

你不能提交任何证据。

约1年 Board 对无新证据且无听证的上诉作出裁决的目标时间约为一年。

Evidence Submission 如果你有其他证据供 Veterans Law Judge 审查，请选择 Evidence Submission。

你必须在 VA 收到你的 Board Appeal 表格之日起90天内提交证据。

更长 如果你添加新证据，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

Hearing Request 如果你希望在附近的 VA 地点与 Veterans Law Judge 进行视频会议听证，请选择 Hearing Request。

在听证会上，你和 Veterans Law Judge 将进行对话，他们会询问你关于上诉的问题。你的听证将被记录并添加到你的上诉档案中。了解更多关于听证会以及如何申请的信息

你可以在听证后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

更长 如果你要求听证，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

2.  ### 在 Part III 中列出你希望上诉的问题

你可以包括 VA 已决定的所有或部分问题。你需要列出你不同意的每个问题及对应的 VA 决定日期。

3.  ### 申请

填写 Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载 VA Form 10182 (PDF)

邮寄

将填写完整的表格发送至以下地址：

Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038

亲自办理

将填写完毕的表格带到地区福利办公室。查找离您最近的地区福利办公室

传真办理

将填写完毕的表格传真至 844-678-8979。

您也可以向地区福利办公室索取此表格的副本进行填写。或者，您可以拨打 VA 免费热线 800-827-1000（周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 9:00）索取表格。

#### 标记您的日历

您有 1 年的时间（自决定日期起）来申请 Board Appeal。如果您是共同申领同一福利的多人之一（这种情况很少见），则您有 60 天的时间。

## Board 决定之后

如果您不同意 Board 的决定，并且有支持您案件的新且相关的证据，您可以提交 Supplemental Claim。您也可以向 U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims 提出上诉。了解 Board 决定后您的更多选择

## 接下来会发生什么？

了解您申请 decision review 后会发生什么

在等待期间，您无需做任何事情，除非 VA 向您发送信函要求提供更多信息。如果 VA 为您安排了考试，请务必不要错过。

跟踪您的上诉状态

## 如果我需要帮助怎么办？

Veterans Service Organization 或 VA 认可的律师或代理人可以帮助您申请 decision review。获取申请 decision review 的帮助

## 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

获取有关 decision reviews 的常见问题解答。前往 FAQs

contexts.text:
[Request a Higher-Level Review > 如果我请求与高级审查员通话，我应该期待什么？]
如果你请求与高级审查员进行非正式会议，他们会拨打你或你的代表在Higher-Level Review表格上提供的电话号码，以安排时间讨论你的案件。高级审查员会尝试通过电话联系你或你的代表两次。如果无人接听，他们会留下语音邮件。

contexts.text:

contexts.text:
[Request a Higher-Level Review > 我可以请求Higher-Level Review吗？]
如果你不同意VA的决定，你可以要求一位高级审查员重新审视你的案件。审查员将根据意见分歧或错误来判断是否可以更改决定。

你不能提交任何证据。

你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

你可以对初始申请或Supplemental Claim的决定请求Higher-Level Review。此选项在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后不可用。如果你是多位申请同一福利的人之一（这种情况很少见），也不可用。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[Request a Higher-Level Review > 如果我请求与高级审查员通话，我应该期待什么？]
如果你请求与高级审查员进行非正式会议，他们会拨打你或你的代表在Higher-Level Review表格上提供的电话号码，以安排时间讨论你的案件。高级审查员会尝试通过电话联系你或你的代表两次。如果无人接听，他们会留下语音邮件。

在通话期间，你和/或你的代表可以讨论你认为决定应该更改的原因并指出错误。这次通话不会有记录。

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Frequently asked questions about decision reviews | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0005
retrieval_contexts.text:
[关于决定复核的常见问题 | 退伍军人事务部 > 如果我请求与退伍军人法律法官举行听证会，我应期待什么？]
您可以选择请求与法官举行听证会。视频会议听证会将在您附近的VA地点进行。

在听证会上，您和法官将进行对话。法官会听取您的证词。法官可能会问您几个问题。您的代表（如果有）可以在听证会上帮助您。

听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉文件中。您可以在听证会后的90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Request a Higher-Level Review | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0000
retrieval_contexts.text:
[Request a Higher-Level Review > 我可以请求Higher-Level Review吗？]
如果你不同意VA的决定，你可以要求一位高级审查员重新审视你的案件。审查员将根据意见分歧或错误来判断是否可以更改决定。

你不能提交任何证据。

你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

你可以对初始申请或Supplemental Claim的决定请求Higher-Level Review。此选项在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后不可用。如果你是多位申请同一福利的人之一（这种情况很少见），也不可用。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[谁能帮有我准备听证会?]
受过上诉程序培训的代表可以帮助你准备听证会以及与法官的对话。你的代表必须是经VA认证的律师、索赔代理人或退伍军人服务组织( VSO )的成员。

在等待期间，您无需做任何事情，除非VA向您发送信函要求更多信息。如果VA为您安排了体检，请务必不要错过。

# 关于 VA 保险选项与资格 | Veterans Affairs

## 关于 VA 保险选项与资格

了解作为 Veteran、service member、spouse 或 dependent child，哪些 VA 保险计划可能适合您。

## 如何知道我符合哪种人寿保险计划的资格？

不同的计划覆盖 Veterans (VGLI)、service members (SGLI) 和 family members (FSGLI)。您也可能通过 TSGLI 获得短期财务保障，以帮助您从 traumatic (severe) injury 中恢复。如果您因 active service 导致或加重的 injury 或 illness 而残疾，您可能可以通过 S-DVI 获得保障，以便在离开军队后继续您的 life insurance 超过 2 年。

注意：如果您即将结束 military tour of duty，您需要迅速获得新的保障。在某些情况下，您必须在离开军队后的 120 天内采取行动，以确保您的保障没有中断。

### VA 人寿保险选项

-

#### Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI)

在服役期间获得团体人寿保险。

-

#### Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)

为您的 spouse 和 dependent children（依赖您提供经济支持的子女）添加保障。

-

#### Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)

获得短期财务支持，帮助您从严重伤害中恢复。

-

#### Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

在结束服役后，获取团体人寿保险。

-

#### 服务性残疾退伍军人保险（S-DVI）

如果你因现役服务导致或加重的伤病而残疾，可在退伍后2年内继续你的人寿保险。

-

#### 退伍军人抵押贷款人寿保险（VMLI）

如果你有严重的服务相关性残疾，可为已改造以适应你需求的住房获取抵押贷款保护保险。

# Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) | Veterans Affairs

## Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

With Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you may be able to keep your life insurance coverage after you leave the military for as long as you continue to pay the premiums. Find out if you qualify for VGLI and how to manage your coverage.

## Am I eligible for Veterans Group Life Insurance?

You may be able to get VGLI if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.

## At least one of these must be true. You:

Had part-time Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) as a member of the National Guard or Reserves, and you suffered an injury or disability (damage to your body or mind that makes it hard for you to do everyday tasks, including meaningful work) while on duty including direct traveling to and from duty that disqualified you for standard premium insurance rates, or Had SGLI while you were in the military and you re within 1 year and 120 days of being released from an active-duty period of 31 or more days, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) of a branch of service, or to the Inactive National Guard (ING). This includes members of the United States Public Health Service Inactive Reserve Corps (IRC), or Are within 1 year and 120 days of being put on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL)

## Who s covered?

## Veterans Former service members

## What life insurance benefits can I get with VGLI?

$10,000 to $400,000 in life insurance benefits, based on the amount of SGLI coverage you had when you left the military.

Note: When you leave the military, you can sign up through VGLI for coverage up to the amount you had through SGLI. You can also increase your coverage by $25,000 every 5 years up to $400,000 until you re 60 years old.

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply for VGLI within one year and 120 days of leaving the military.

If you sign up within 240 days of leaving the military, you won t need to prove you re in good health. If you sign up after the 240-day period, you ll need to submit evidence that you re in good health.

## Apply in one of these ways:

Apply through the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI), using the Prudential website. Apply online through OSGLI Apply online through eBenefits Apply by mail or fax. Fill out the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (SGLV 8714). Download the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

To reinstate a VGLI policy that has expired, you ll need to fill out an Application for Reinstatement of VGLI Coverage (SGLV 180). Download SGLV 180 (PDF)

## How much will I pay for these benefits?

VGLI premium rates are based on your age and the amount of insurance coverage you want.

Choose your age to find monthly premium rates as of July 1, 2014.

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## See the VGLI premium rates before July 1, 2014

## Can I choose or update my beneficiaries?

Yes. You can choose your beneficiaries (the people you pick to get the money from your life insurance policy if you die) and change them as needed.

## Update your beneficiary information in one of these ways:

Access your policy online. Find your policy through Prudential Life Insurance Company of America, or Fill out a VGLI Beneficiary Designation form (SGLV 8721). Download SGLV 8721 (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

## Can I convert my VGLI policy into a commercial policy?

Yes. You can convert your policy into a commercial (civilian) policy at any time. You ll be able to convert at standard premium rates, without having to provide proof that you re in good health.

## To convert your VGLI policy:

## Choose your new insurance company.View our list of companies that take part in this program (PDF)

Apply at the local sales office of your chosen company.

Get a letter from OSGLI confirming that you have VGLI coverage (called a VGLI Conversion Notice) and give the letter to the agent who takes your application.

Note: The conversion policy must be a permanent policy, such as a whole life policy. You can t convert to other types of policies, like term, variable life, or universal life insurance. And supplementary policy benefits, like Accidental Death and Dismemberment or Waiver of Premium for Disability, aren t considered part of the conversion policy.

## What if I need help with my claim?

If you have questions about Servicemembers or Veterans Group Life Insurance, you can call the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI) at 800-419-1473 or email the Prudential Insurance Company.

## Which forms would my family member need?

To request an advance insurance payment for a service member who s terminally ill, a family member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284).Download SGLV 8284 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a family member would file a Claim for Death Benefits (SGLV 8283).Download SGLV 8283 (PDF)

[军人团体人寿保险（SGLI） > 在您退役或退休时申请VGLI]
### 当我离开军队时如何申请VGLI？

当您离开军队时，您可以在退伍后1年零120天内申请退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI），最高保额为您通过SGLI拥有的保险金额。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

您还可以在离开军队之日起120天内将您的SGLI保单转换为 civilian 保单。了解如何将您的SGLI保障转换为个人保单（PDF）

### 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保障吗？

如果您在离军日期后2年内，并且满足以下任一要求，您可能可以在离开军队之日起保留保障最多2年。

以下至少一项必须为真：

- 您在退伍时完全残疾且无法工作，或
- 无论您的工作状况如何，您已患有以下情况之一：
  - 双耳完全失聪
  - 丧失言语能力，即使借助人工设备也无法低声说话
  - 双手、双脚或双眼，或一只手和一只脚，或一只手或一只脚和一只眼睛永久（长期）丧失功能

### 我如何申请SGLI残疾延长？

您需要申请军人团体人寿保险残疾延长（SGLI-DE）。

要申请，请填写SGLI残疾延长申请表（SGLV 8715）并将其发送至申请表上列出的OSGLI地址。下载SGLV 8715（PDF）

如果您的申请获得批准，您将在离军日期后20个月收到通知，告知您的SGLI-DE即将结束，并且您现在可以选择支付保费以参加退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）。

如果您支付保费，只要您持续支付保费，您就可以保留您的人寿保险保障。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

### 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

如果您对军人或退伍军人团体人寿保险有疑问，您可以拨打军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）电话800-419-1473，或发送电子邮件至保德信保险公司。

### 我的家人需要哪些表格？

- 要为患有绝症的军人申请预付保险金，家属需提交加速给付索赔表（SGLV 8284）。下载SGLV 8284（PDF）
- 要在需要时获得保险金，家属需提交死亡抚恤金索赔表（SGLV 8283）。下载SGLV 8283（PDF）
- 要帮助军人在创伤性损伤恢复期间获得短期经济支持，家属需与军人共同提交TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600）。下载SGLV 8600（PDF）

### 我可以获得哪些类型的人寿保险福利？

您可以获得：

- 最高限额为400,000美元，以50,000美元为增量递增的保险
- 从您离开军队之日起120天的免费保险
- 当您离开军队时，如果您完全残疾，免费保险可延长至多2年。请参阅下方关于SGLI残疾延期的信息
- 兼职保险（如果您是不符合全职保险资格的预备役成员）

### 我如何获得这些福利？

如果您符合SGLI的资格，我们将通过您的军种自动为您注册。详情请咨询您所在单位的人事办公室。

### 我可以更改我的福利吗？

可以。您可以选择您的保险金额，甚至完全拒绝保险。您也可以选择您的受益人（您指定在您去世后从人寿保险单中获得保险金的人），并根据需要更改他们。

### 如何更改您的受益人或减少、拒绝或恢复您的SGLI保险

如果您是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或国家海洋和大气管理局的成员，请通过SGLI在线注册系统（SOES）在线提交您的更改。要访问SOES：

1.  前往milConnect

2.  登录。

3.  前往福利，人寿保险SOES-SGLI在线注册系统。

4.  检查您的保险和受益人信息，并进行任何必要的更新。

一旦您收到可以开始使用SOES的通知，您就可以使用CAC或DS Logon通过Internet Explorer登录。

如果您是公共卫生署的成员，请填写《军人团体人寿保险选择和证明》（SGLV 8286）并将其交给您单位的人事官员来提交您的更改。下载SGLV 8286（PDF）了解更多关于SOES的信息

# 关于 VA 保险选项与资格 | Veterans Affairs

## 关于 VA 保险选项与资格

了解作为 Veteran、service member、spouse 或 dependent child，哪些 VA 保险计划可能适合您。

## 如何知道我符合哪种人寿保险计划的资格？

不同的计划覆盖 Veterans (VGLI)、service members (SGLI) 和 family members (FSGLI)。您也可能通过 TSGLI 获得短期财务保障，以帮助您从 traumatic (severe) injury 中恢复。如果您因 active service 导致或加重的 injury 或 illness 而残疾，您可能可以通过 S-DVI 获得保障，以便在离开军队后继续您的 life insurance 超过 2 年。

注意：如果您即将结束 military tour of duty，您需要迅速获得新的保障。在某些情况下，您必须在离开军队后的 120 天内采取行动，以确保您的保障没有中断。

### VA 人寿保险选项

-

#### Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI)

在服役期间获得团体人寿保险。

-

#### Family Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (FSGLI)

为您的 spouse 和 dependent children（依赖您提供经济支持的子女）添加保障。

-

#### Traumatic Injury Protection (TSGLI)

获得短期财务支持，帮助您从严重伤害中恢复。

-

#### Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

在结束服役后，获取团体人寿保险。

-

#### 服务性残疾退伍军人保险（S-DVI）

如果你因现役服务导致或加重的伤病而残疾，可在退伍后2年内继续你的人寿保险。

-

#### 退伍军人抵押贷款人寿保险（VMLI）

如果你有严重的服务相关性残疾，可为已改造以适应你需求的住房获取抵押贷款保护保险。

# Veterans’ Group Life Insurance (VGLI) | Veterans Affairs

## Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI)

With Veterans Group Life Insurance (VGLI), you may be able to keep your life insurance coverage after you leave the military for as long as you continue to pay the premiums. Find out if you qualify for VGLI and how to manage your coverage.

## Am I eligible for Veterans Group Life Insurance?

You may be able to get VGLI if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.

## At least one of these must be true. You:

Had part-time Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (SGLI) as a member of the National Guard or Reserves, and you suffered an injury or disability (damage to your body or mind that makes it hard for you to do everyday tasks, including meaningful work) while on duty including direct traveling to and from duty that disqualified you for standard premium insurance rates, or Had SGLI while you were in the military and you re within 1 year and 120 days of being released from an active-duty period of 31 or more days, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of retiring or being released from the Ready Reserves or National Guard, or Are within 1 year and 120 days of assignment to the Individual Ready Reserves (IRR) of a branch of service, or to the Inactive National Guard (ING). This includes members of the United States Public Health Service Inactive Reserve Corps (IRC), or Are within 1 year and 120 days of being put on the Temporary Disability Retirement List (TDRL)

## Who s covered?

## Veterans Former service members

## What life insurance benefits can I get with VGLI?

$10,000 to $400,000 in life insurance benefits, based on the amount of SGLI coverage you had when you left the military.

Note: When you leave the military, you can sign up through VGLI for coverage up to the amount you had through SGLI. You can also increase your coverage by $25,000 every 5 years up to $400,000 until you re 60 years old.

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply for VGLI within one year and 120 days of leaving the military.

If you sign up within 240 days of leaving the military, you won t need to prove you re in good health. If you sign up after the 240-day period, you ll need to submit evidence that you re in good health.

## Apply in one of these ways:

Apply through the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI), using the Prudential website. Apply online through OSGLI Apply online through eBenefits Apply by mail or fax. Fill out the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (SGLV 8714). Download the Application for Veterans Group Life Insurance (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

To reinstate a VGLI policy that has expired, you ll need to fill out an Application for Reinstatement of VGLI Coverage (SGLV 180). Download SGLV 180 (PDF)

## How much will I pay for these benefits?

VGLI premium rates are based on your age and the amount of insurance coverage you want.

Choose your age to find monthly premium rates as of July 1, 2014.

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## -

## See the VGLI premium rates before July 1, 2014

## Can I choose or update my beneficiaries?

Yes. You can choose your beneficiaries (the people you pick to get the money from your life insurance policy if you die) and change them as needed.

## Update your beneficiary information in one of these ways:

Access your policy online. Find your policy through Prudential Life Insurance Company of America, or Fill out a VGLI Beneficiary Designation form (SGLV 8721). Download SGLV 8721 (PDF)

## Fax the form to 800-236-6142, or mail it to:

## OSGLI PO Box 41618 Philadelphia, PA 19176-9913

## Can I convert my VGLI policy into a commercial policy?

Yes. You can convert your policy into a commercial (civilian) policy at any time. You ll be able to convert at standard premium rates, without having to provide proof that you re in good health.

## To convert your VGLI policy:

## Choose your new insurance company.View our list of companies that take part in this program (PDF)

Apply at the local sales office of your chosen company.

Get a letter from OSGLI confirming that you have VGLI coverage (called a VGLI Conversion Notice) and give the letter to the agent who takes your application.

Note: The conversion policy must be a permanent policy, such as a whole life policy. You can t convert to other types of policies, like term, variable life, or universal life insurance. And supplementary policy benefits, like Accidental Death and Dismemberment or Waiver of Premium for Disability, aren t considered part of the conversion policy.

## What if I need help with my claim?

If you have questions about Servicemembers or Veterans Group Life Insurance, you can call the Office of Servicemembers Group Life Insurance (OSGLI) at 800-419-1473 or email the Prudential Insurance Company.

## Which forms would my family member need?

To request an advance insurance payment for a service member who s terminally ill, a family member would file a Claim for Accelerated Benefits (SGLV 8284).Download SGLV 8284 (PDF) To receive an insurance payment in their time of need, a family member would file a Claim for Death Benefits (SGLV 8283).Download SGLV 8283 (PDF)

### 当我离开军队时如何申请VGLI？

当您离开军队时，您可以在退伍后1年零120天内申请退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI），最高保额为您通过SGLI拥有的保险金额。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

您还可以在离开军队之日起120天内将您的SGLI保单转换为 civilian 保单。了解如何将您的SGLI保障转换为个人保单（PDF）

### 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保障吗？

如果您在离军日期后2年内，并且满足以下任一要求，您可能可以在离开军队之日起保留保障最多2年。

以下至少一项必须为真：

- 您在退伍时完全残疾且无法工作，或
- 无论您的工作状况如何，您已患有以下情况之一：
  - 双耳完全失聪
  - 丧失言语能力，即使借助人工设备也无法低声说话
  - 双手、双脚或双眼，或一只手和一只脚，或一只手或一只脚和一只眼睛永久（长期）丧失功能

### 我如何申请SGLI残疾延长？

您需要申请军人团体人寿保险残疾延长（SGLI-DE）。

要申请，请填写SGLI残疾延长申请表（SGLV 8715）并将其发送至申请表上列出的OSGLI地址。下载SGLV 8715（PDF）

如果您的申请获得批准，您将在离军日期后20个月收到通知，告知您的SGLI-DE即将结束，并且您现在可以选择支付保费以参加退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）。

如果您支付保费，只要您持续支付保费，您就可以保留您的人寿保险保障。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

### 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

如果您对军人或退伍军人团体人寿保险有疑问，您可以拨打军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）电话800-419-1473，或发送电子邮件至保德信保险公司。

### 我的家人需要哪些表格？

- 要为患有绝症的军人申请预付保险金，家属需提交加速给付索赔表（SGLV 8284）。下载SGLV 8284（PDF）
- 要在需要时获得保险金，家属需提交死亡抚恤金索赔表（SGLV 8283）。下载SGLV 8283（PDF）
- 要帮助军人在创伤性损伤恢复期间获得短期经济支持，家属需与军人共同提交TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600）。下载SGLV 8600（PDF）

# Unsatisfied Judgments

### I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?

To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.

If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.

If you do not know which court to contact, you can call the NY State DMV Insurance Services Bureau. See Contact us [1].

### How do I get an unsatisfied judgment against another motorist?

To get an unsatisfied judgment against a motorist as a result of a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash, you must file a Supporting Affirmation (PDF) [2] (SR-60) and the other documents listed on the affirmation (SR-60).

### Will the DMV suspend the driver license and all of the registrations of a person who has an unsatisfied judgment against them?

Yes. The DMV will suspend the license and registrations if the person fails to pay or satisfy a judgment of more than $1,000 and the judgment is related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash which causes property damage, bodily injury or death.

The DMV will also suspend

- all vehicle registrations of the company
- the privilege to register another vehicle

# Tickets received in another state

### What happens if I get a traffic ticket in another state?

#### Moving violations

Your NY State Driver License will be suspended if you fail to answer a ticket for a moving violation in any state except Alaska, California, Michigan, Montana, Oregon or Wisconsin. Your license will remain suspended until you answer the ticket.

Drivers from any state, except those from the six states listed above, will have their driver licenses suspended in their own state for failure to answer a moving violation in New York State.

The New York State DMV does not record out-of-state convictions of moving traffic violations of New York State non-commercial licensed drivers, except for traffic offenses committed in the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada.

#### Alcohol and drug violations

##### If you are 21 or older

If you are 21 years of age or older when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation in any other state or the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least 90 days. Out-of-state drivers ticketed in New York State should contact the Motor Vehicle Department of their own state or province about the effect of a conviction in New York State.

##### If you are under 21

If you are under the age of 21 when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation that occurs out-of-state and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least one year. If you have any prior alcohol or drug related driving conviction, your license will be revoked for at least one year or until the age of 21, whichever is longer.

#### Convictions for criminal negligence, homicide or assault

The New York State DMV records the out-of-state convictions of any New York driver for criminal negligence, homicide, or assault, which arise out of the operation of a motor vehicle and which results in death. As a result of any of these convictions, your NY State Driver License will be revoked.

# Tickets received in New York City

DMV s Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB) processes tickets for non-criminal moving traffic violations issued in the five boroughs of New York City. 1 For more information about the TVB, you can read our brochure [1].

### How do I answer a TVB ticket?

You can answer most TVB tickets online [2]. You can either schedule a hearing for the traffic ticket, or you can pay the fine and surcharge with your credit card. For more information, see how to plead to or pay TVB tickets [3].

To answer your ticket by mail, enter your plea on the ticket and include the appropriate fee if pleading guilty.

Mail to

Traffic Violations Plea UnitP.O. Box 2950 - ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0950

To answer your ticket at a TVB office, follow the instructions on the ticket. Be sure to bring proof of identity such as your driver license.

### What happens if I do not answer a TVB traffic ticket?

If you do not answer a traffic ticket on time, your driver license will be suspended. It is a crime to drive with a suspended license. A suspension for the failure to answer a ticket does not indicate that you are guilty of the charge. The suspension only indicates that you failed to answer the ticket. To remove the suspension, you must contact the court to

- answer the ticket
- pay a $70 suspension termination fee

### What happens if I do not respond to my TVB ticket after I receive a suspension notice?

If you continue to ignore the ticket after your license is suspended for failure to answer the ticket, you will automatically be convicted of the charge. This is known as a 'default conviction.' The default conviction is equivalent to a guilty finding. The DMV then suspends your driver license for your failure to pay the fine. To terminate the suspension resulting from the default conviction, you must pay the fine, mandatory surcharge and the suspension termination fees. 2

Note: Some convictions can cause the suspension or the revocation of your driver license. For more information, see Suspensions and Revocations [4] or read the DMV brochure Suppose Your License Were Taken Away [5].

### What happens if I plead guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points?

If you have 3 or more alcohol-related convictions on your entire driving record, a plea of guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points may result in the revocation of your license under Part 132 of the Commissioner's Regulations. You may want to consult with an attorney before entering your plea.

- 1. In other parts of New York State, traffic violations are processed in the criminal or traffic court of the city, county, town or village where the alleged offense took place. To answer these types of traffic tickets, contact the court directly.
- 2. A suspension due to a traffic ticket is an '**indefinite**' suspension. An indefinite suspension means your driver license or privilege to drive is taken away until you pay a suspension termination fee of $70 and have valid driver license.

[Traffic Violations Bureau]
## What To Do If You Receive A Traffic Ticket

## INTRODUCTION

## If you are issued a ticket for a non-criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New

York City, it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked (aggravated unlicensed operation). However, TVBs do not handle parking violations.

If you plead not guilty to a traffic ticket in one of these TVB areas, your case will be heard by a DMV Administrative Law Judge (ALJ), an experienced attorney with special training in the Vehicle

## and Traffic Law. An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if

you are found guilty. An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

Just as in traffic courts in other areas of the state, you may present witnesses and evidence ata hearing before an ALJ and be represented by an attorney.

## IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET

Follow the instructions on the ticket for the plea you wish to make, and act promptly.

If you don't answer the ticket in the time allowed, your driver license will be suspended. Later, you could be found guilty of the charge because of your failure to respond (a default conviction). Your license would be suspended for not paying the fine and a judgment would be entered against you.

Driving with a suspended license is a crime. A felony conviction may result in fines of up to $5,000, jail, probation, or confiscation of your vehicle. As the number of suspensions you have increases, the penalties also increase. A driver is suspended for ticket not answered and fine not paid.

To Plead Not Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the “not guilty" instructions and check the “not guilty” box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it, and mail the ticket to the Albany address listed. DMV will send

## you a letter telling you when and where to go for your hearing. If you are hearing impaired and

require an interpreter, include a request for one when you mail your not guilty plea. An interpreter will be assigned to your hearing at no charge to you.

## ATTEND YOUR HEARING

Hearings are open to the public. You may go to any TVB office to watch hearings so you know what to expect at yours.

To Plead Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the instructions and check the "guilty" box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it and, , either mail it with your payment to the Albany address listed on the ticket or bring your payment to any TVB office. You may pay the fine and surcharge by Visa or Mastercard, or by a check or money order payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. Include the total fines and surcharges listed on the ticket for your violation(s).

You may not plead guilty by mail if the charge against you will result in license or registration suspension or revocation upon conviction (such as driving without insurance or a third speeding violation within 18 months). If you plead guilty to such a charge by mail, you will be notified that you must go to the TVB to answer the charge in person.

IsGee

You are considered innocent of the charge against you unless you are proven guilty at your hearing. You cannot be found guilty unless there is "clear and convincing evidence" that you committed the violation.

If you find it hard to understand English, you may bring someone to help you. Tell the ALJ, before the hearing starts, that someone who speaks your native language and English is there to interpret.

The ALJ will listen to sworn testimony from the police officer, who will explain why you were given the ticket. Then, you or your attorney may ask the officer questions. You also may bring witnesses to testify for you and written evidence. The judge may ask witnesses questions to better understand their testimony.

You do not have to testify but you may if you wish. You cannot be found guilty just because you do not testify.

When all of the evidence and testimony have been given, the ALJ will decide whether or not you are guilty. That decision will be based only on the evidence and testimony presented at the hearing and what the law states. If the ALJ decides the charge against you was not proven by clear and convincing evidence, you will be found not guilty. If the charge is proven and you are found guilty, the judge will set a fine. Your license or registration also may be suspended or revoked, depending on the violation and your overall driving record.

## APPEALS

If you believe the ALJ's decision was incorrect based on the facts and the law, you may file an appeal. You can determine if you can file an appeal online [2] or download Traffic Violations Bureau Appeal form [3] (AA-33) from the DMV web site. The appeal form is also available at TVB offices. Read the instructions carefully. If you wish, your attorney may help you file the appeal. Remember to include a payment for the appeal fees. An appeal must be filed , and the appeal form and fees must be sent to:

# Unsatisfied Judgments

### I received a suspension order for an unsatisfied judgment related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash. What do I need to do?

To remove a suspension related to an unsatisfied judgment, you must resolve the judgment.

If you were notified that there is an unsatisfied judgment suspension on your record you must contact the attorney or court that issued the judgment. The information on the suspension order will advise you of the name of the court and the court index number for the judgment. The DMV cannot clear the suspension without proof from the court. Once you receive the original documentation from the court or attorney, you must send the original documents to DMV for clearance.

If you do not know which court to contact, you can call the NY State DMV Insurance Services Bureau. See Contact us [1].

### How do I get an unsatisfied judgment against another motorist?

To get an unsatisfied judgment against a motorist as a result of a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash, you must file a Supporting Affirmation (PDF) [2] (SR-60) and the other documents listed on the affirmation (SR-60).

### Will the DMV suspend the driver license and all of the registrations of a person who has an unsatisfied judgment against them?

Yes. The DMV will suspend the license and registrations if the person fails to pay or satisfy a judgment of more than $1,000 and the judgment is related to a motor vehicle accident, collision or crash which causes property damage, bodily injury or death.

The DMV will also suspend

- all vehicle registrations of the company
- the privilege to register another vehicle

# Tickets received in another state

### What happens if I get a traffic ticket in another state?

#### Moving violations

Your NY State Driver License will be suspended if you fail to answer a ticket for a moving violation in any state except Alaska, California, Michigan, Montana, Oregon or Wisconsin. Your license will remain suspended until you answer the ticket.

Drivers from any state, except those from the six states listed above, will have their driver licenses suspended in their own state for failure to answer a moving violation in New York State.

The New York State DMV does not record out-of-state convictions of moving traffic violations of New York State non-commercial licensed drivers, except for traffic offenses committed in the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada.

#### Alcohol and drug violations

##### If you are 21 or older

If you are 21 years of age or older when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation in any other state or the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least 90 days. Out-of-state drivers ticketed in New York State should contact the Motor Vehicle Department of their own state or province about the effect of a conviction in New York State.

##### If you are under 21

If you are under the age of 21 when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation that occurs out-of-state and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least one year. If you have any prior alcohol or drug related driving conviction, your license will be revoked for at least one year or until the age of 21, whichever is longer.

#### Convictions for criminal negligence, homicide or assault

The New York State DMV records the out-of-state convictions of any New York driver for criminal negligence, homicide, or assault, which arise out of the operation of a motor vehicle and which results in death. As a result of any of these convictions, your NY State Driver License will be revoked.

# Tickets received in New York City

DMV s Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB) processes tickets for non-criminal moving traffic violations issued in the five boroughs of New York City. 1 For more information about the TVB, you can read our brochure [1].

### How do I answer a TVB ticket?

You can answer most TVB tickets online [2]. You can either schedule a hearing for the traffic ticket, or you can pay the fine and surcharge with your credit card. For more information, see how to plead to or pay TVB tickets [3].

To answer your ticket by mail, enter your plea on the ticket and include the appropriate fee if pleading guilty.

Mail to

Traffic Violations Plea UnitP.O. Box 2950 - ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0950

To answer your ticket at a TVB office, follow the instructions on the ticket. Be sure to bring proof of identity such as your driver license.

### What happens if I do not answer a TVB traffic ticket?

If you do not answer a traffic ticket on time, your driver license will be suspended. It is a crime to drive with a suspended license. A suspension for the failure to answer a ticket does not indicate that you are guilty of the charge. The suspension only indicates that you failed to answer the ticket. To remove the suspension, you must contact the court to

- answer the ticket
- pay a $70 suspension termination fee

### What happens if I do not respond to my TVB ticket after I receive a suspension notice?

If you continue to ignore the ticket after your license is suspended for failure to answer the ticket, you will automatically be convicted of the charge. This is known as a 'default conviction.' The default conviction is equivalent to a guilty finding. The DMV then suspends your driver license for your failure to pay the fine. To terminate the suspension resulting from the default conviction, you must pay the fine, mandatory surcharge and the suspension termination fees. 2

Note: Some convictions can cause the suspension or the revocation of your driver license. For more information, see Suspensions and Revocations [4] or read the DMV brochure Suppose Your License Were Taken Away [5].

### What happens if I plead guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points?

If you have 3 or more alcohol-related convictions on your entire driving record, a plea of guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points may result in the revocation of your license under Part 132 of the Commissioner's Regulations. You may want to consult with an attorney before entering your plea.

- 1. In other parts of New York State, traffic violations are processed in the criminal or traffic court of the city, county, town or village where the alleged offense took place. To answer these types of traffic tickets, contact the court directly.
- 2. A suspension due to a traffic ticket is an '**indefinite**' suspension. An indefinite suspension means your driver license or privilege to drive is taken away until you pay a suspension termination fee of $70 and have valid driver license.

[Traffic Violations Bureau]
## What To Do If You Receive A Traffic Ticket

## INTRODUCTION

## If you are issued a ticket for a non-criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New

York City, it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked (aggravated unlicensed operation). However, TVBs do not handle parking violations.

If you plead not guilty to a traffic ticket in one of these TVB areas, your case will be heard by a DMV Administrative Law Judge (ALJ), an experienced attorney with special training in the Vehicle

## and Traffic Law. An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if

you are found guilty. An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

Just as in traffic courts in other areas of the state, you may present witnesses and evidence ata hearing before an ALJ and be represented by an attorney.

## IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET

Follow the instructions on the ticket for the plea you wish to make, and act promptly.

If you don't answer the ticket in the time allowed, your driver license will be suspended. Later, you could be found guilty of the charge because of your failure to respond (a default conviction). Your license would be suspended for not paying the fine and a judgment would be entered against you.

Driving with a suspended license is a crime. A felony conviction may result in fines of up to $5,000, jail, probation, or confiscation of your vehicle. As the number of suspensions you have increases, the penalties also increase. A driver is suspended for ticket not answered and fine not paid.

To Plead Not Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the “not guilty" instructions and check the “not guilty” box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it, and mail the ticket to the Albany address listed. DMV will send

## you a letter telling you when and where to go for your hearing. If you are hearing impaired and

require an interpreter, include a request for one when you mail your not guilty plea. An interpreter will be assigned to your hearing at no charge to you.

## ATTEND YOUR HEARING

Hearings are open to the public. You may go to any TVB office to watch hearings so you know what to expect at yours.

To Plead Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the instructions and check the "guilty" box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it and, , either mail it with your payment to the Albany address listed on the ticket or bring your payment to any TVB office. You may pay the fine and surcharge by Visa or Mastercard, or by a check or money order payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. Include the total fines and surcharges listed on the ticket for your violation(s).

You may not plead guilty by mail if the charge against you will result in license or registration suspension or revocation upon conviction (such as driving without insurance or a third speeding violation within 18 months). If you plead guilty to such a charge by mail, you will be notified that you must go to the TVB to answer the charge in person.

IsGee

You are considered innocent of the charge against you unless you are proven guilty at your hearing. You cannot be found guilty unless there is "clear and convincing evidence" that you committed the violation.

If you find it hard to understand English, you may bring someone to help you. Tell the ALJ, before the hearing starts, that someone who speaks your native language and English is there to interpret.

The ALJ will listen to sworn testimony from the police officer, who will explain why you were given the ticket. Then, you or your attorney may ask the officer questions. You also may bring witnesses to testify for you and written evidence. The judge may ask witnesses questions to better understand their testimony.

You do not have to testify but you may if you wish. You cannot be found guilty just because you do not testify.

When all of the evidence and testimony have been given, the ALJ will decide whether or not you are guilty. That decision will be based only on the evidence and testimony presented at the hearing and what the law states. If the ALJ decides the charge against you was not proven by clear and convincing evidence, you will be found not guilty. If the charge is proven and you are found guilty, the judge will set a fine. Your license or registration also may be suspended or revoked, depending on the violation and your overall driving record.

## APPEALS

If you believe the ALJ's decision was incorrect based on the facts and the law, you may file an appeal. You can determine if you can file an appeal online [2] or download Traffic Violations Bureau Appeal form [3] (AA-33) from the DMV web site. The appeal form is also available at TVB offices. Read the instructions carefully. If you wish, your attorney may help you file the appeal. Remember to include a payment for the appeal fees. # Learn about personalized plates

## What are personalized plates?

Personalized plates are standard series plates that have a combination of numbers and letters that you select, for an additional fee in addition to your regular vehicle registration fee. 1

## How much do personalized plates cost?

## Passenger and Commercial Plates: Initial Cost = $60.00Annual Fee = $31.25

Motorcycle Plates:Initial Cost = $35.00Annual Fee = $18.75

## Can | use personalized plates on any type of vehicle?

You can use personalized plates on passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, motorcycles and trailers.

## What can | use for a personalized plate combination?

Your requested plate combination is subject to review. The DMV is not required to issue your requested plate.

The maximum number of characters you can use depends on the plate type you are registering. 2 You can have up to

- eight characters on a standard series plate

- six characters on a personalized plate for a motorcycle

- six characters on a picture plate

- the state image is available on some personalized plates and counts as a character. See the example [1]. Check if the personalized plate combination you want is available. [2]

## What plate combinations are restricted?

- Personalized plates that give the appearance of an official plate or the configuration of special registration classes. 3

- Combinations that are considered obscene, derogatory or offensive.

- Combinations that do not have one letter.

- Combinations that consist of six numbers followed by one letter.

- Use of the letter "O" between two numbers to make what appears to be a number. 4

- Use of the letter "I" as the first or last characters on a plate when the other characters are all numbers. 5

- Use of the number zero (0) between two letters to form a word. 6

- Use of the number zero (0) and the letter "O" to form a word or number. 7 Read the DMV regulations for restrictions on personalized plate combinations [3].

# Can picture plates be personalized?

Yes. Some picture plates can be personalized for an additional fee in addition to your picture plate and regular registration fee. For personalized plate availability and pricing for the picture plate you are interested in, you can browse our collection of picture plates online. The categories are:

- | Love NY Adventure [4]

- Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [8]

- Causes [9]

- Professions [10]

- Organizations [11]

- Motorcycle Plates [12]

- 3. For example, a combination that includes "POLICE" or "NYS" is not allowed.

- 4. For example, "203", "2003", or "JAN2003" are not allowed.

- 5. For example, "145678" or "456781" are not allowed.

contexts.text:
[Information and Instructions About Your Certificate of Title > How do I obtain a title?]
Most often, you automatically apply for a when you first register your motor vehicle or motorboat. Use the form Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [1] (MV-82), available at any motor vehicle office, by request from a DMV Call Center or by download from the DMV internet site. You must pay the registration and license plate fees, any appropriate sales tax, and the fee for a title certificate $50.00. The same process is followed by a dealership that handles your registration and title application. The dealership will issue you a temporary registration.

You will receive your permanent registration, and license plates if requested, when the Department of Motor Vehicles accepts your application. However, New York State title certificates are not issued over the counter. State law requires the DMV to mail a title certificate to the owner, after carefully examining and verifying the proof of ownership submitted with the application. As a result, the title application process may take several weeks to complete.

If you do not receive your title certificate by mail within 90 days after you apply, contact a DMV Call Center. Your registration receipt can help verify your vehicle's plate number, make, year and vehicle identification number (VIN).

When you receive your title, check to see whether the information it contains about your vehicle is correct and agrees with the information on the vehicle registration document. If the title is incorrect, contact the DMV Call Center and ask about obtaining an amended title. If both the registration and title are incorrect, bring them to a motor vehicle office.

- Combinations that are considered obscene, derogatory or offensive.

- Combinations that do not have one letter.

- Combinations that consist of six numbers followed by one letter.

- Use of the letter "O" between two numbers to make what appears to be a number. 4

- Use of the letter "I" as the first or last characters on a plate when the other characters are all numbers. 5

- Use of the number zero (0) between two letters to form a word. 6

- Use of the number zero (0) and the letter "O" to form a word or number. 7 Read the DMV regulations for restrictions on personalized plate combinations [3].

# Can picture plates be personalized?

Yes. Some picture plates can be personalized for an additional fee in addition to your picture plate and regular registration fee. For personalized plate availability and pricing for the picture plate you are interested in, you can browse our collection of picture plates online. The categories are:

- | Love NY Adventure [4]

- Sports [5]

- Military and Veterans [6]

- Counties and Regions of NY State [7]

- Colleges, Fraternities, Sororities [8]

- Causes [9]

- Professions [10]

- Organizations [11]

- Motorcycle Plates [12]

- 1. The annual fee is in addition to your vehicle registration renewal fee and will be paid when you renew your registration. A registration renewal for two years will include two annual fees.

- 2. Acharacter is a letter (A-Z), number (0-9) or space. Each space counts as one character.

- 3. For example, a combination that includes "POLICE" or "NYS" is not allowed.

- 4. For example, "203", "2003", or "JAN2003" are not allowed.

- 5. For example, "145678" or "456781" are not allowed.

- 6. For example, "POOL" and "POLE" are not allowed.

- 7. For example, "POOL" or "2003" are not allowed.

# 如何更换车辆注册证

# 如何更换车辆注册证 [1]

更换车辆注册文件和挡风玻璃贴纸的费用为 $3.00，除非您同时更换车牌。1

如果您需要更换因犯罪而丢失的车牌或文件，您必须通过邮寄或前往DMV办公室申请。有关更多信息，请参阅丢失或被盗车牌 [2]。

### 在线办理并打印临时文件

您可以在线更换大多数车辆的注册文件。您的电脑必须接受cookies。2

#### 抱歉，您无法在线更换以下车辆的注册文件

- 1973年款之前的车辆
- 船只、雪地摩托或全地形车（ATV）
- 注册已过期、被放弃、暂停或吊销的车辆
- 摩托车或其他带有车牌贴纸的车辆
- 拖车
- 运输车辆
- 通过DMV国际注册局注册的车辆

#### 临时注册

您可以下载并打印有效期10天的临时注册PDF文件。我们也会将副本附在您的确认邮件中。您将在10天内通过邮件收到新的注册文件。

#### 您需要

- 车牌号或注册号
- 注册类别
- 注册地址对应的邮政编码
- 用于支付的信用卡或无密码借记卡

在线更换注册 [4]

### 通过邮寄

发送以下材料

- 填写完整的《重复/续期注册申请表》(PDF) [5] (MV-82D)
- 您的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证、非驾驶员ID或其他身份证明的复印件 [6]
- 一张 $3 的支票/汇票，收款人为“机动车管理局局长”

至

New York State Department of Motor VehiclesUtica Processing CenterP.O. Box 359Utica, NY 13503

您不能通过邮件更新您的姓名。如果您的地址有变，请在申请表上写上您的新地址。

### 在DMV办公室

使用《补发/续期注册申请表》(MV-82D)，并携带以下物品到DMV办公室 [7]

- 一份填写完整的《补发/续期注册申请表》(PDF) [5] (MV-82D)
- 您的纽约州驾照、许可证、非驾驶员ID，或其他身份证明 [6]
- 支付费用$3

### 如果您的地址有变

您在DMV档案中的邮寄地址必须是最新的。您不能在交易期间更改地址。您可以先在线更改地址 [8]，然后再续期。

注意：如果您向美国邮政服务(USPS)提交转寄邮件的请求，不保证USPS会将所有DMV文件转寄到新地址。

### 如果您的姓名有变

您不能在此交易期间更改姓名。您的新文件将显示您之前的姓名。如果您最近更改了姓名，请阅读更改注册或所有权证上姓名或其他信息的说明 [9]。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[Information and Instructions About Your Certificate of Title > How do I obtain a title?]
Most often, you automatically apply for a when you first register your motor vehicle or motorboat. Use the form Vehicle Registration/Title Application (PDF) [1] (MV-82), available at any motor vehicle office, by request from a DMV Call Center or by download from the DMV internet site. You must pay the registration and license plate fees, any appropriate sales tax, and the fee for a title certificate $50.00. The same process is followed by a dealership that handles your registration and title application. The dealership will issue you a temporary registration.

You will receive your permanent registration, and license plates if requested, when the Department of Motor Vehicles accepts your application. However, New York State title certificates are not issued over the counter. State law requires the DMV to mail a title certificate to the owner, after carefully examining and verifying the proof of ownership submitted with the application. As a result, the title application process may take several weeks to complete.

If you do not receive your title certificate by mail within 90 days after you apply, contact a DMV Call Center. Your registration receipt can help verify your vehicle's plate number, make, year and vehicle identification number (VIN).

When you receive your title, check to see whether the information it contains about your vehicle is correct and agrees with the information on the vehicle registration document. If the title is incorrect, contact the DMV Call Center and ask about obtaining an amended title. If both the registration and title are incorrect, bring them to a motor vehicle office.

[探索您可能有权获得的福利 > 您或您的家人可能有资格获得增加的福利 > 联系社会保障局]
我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的父母福利。

您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获得福利。

您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信息：http://www.va.gov/

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾人。

重要提示：如果您正在领取福利，有某些生活事件您必须报告。如需完整列表，请选择下方适用于您所领取福利类型的出版物。

注意：未能报告变更可能导致多付款项。

领取退休或遗属福利时您需要了解的事项（第7-13页）

领取社会保障残疾福利时您需要了解的事项（第11-18页）

领取补充保障收入（SSI）时您需要了解的事项（第7-19页）

我们的网站是了解社会保障局所有计划信息的重要资源。您可以在线办理许多事项。

除了使用我们的网站，您还可以拨打我们的免费电话1-800-772-1213。我们对所有通话保密。我们可以在周一至周五上午7点至下午7点回答具体问题。通常，如果您在周二之后的工作日打电话，等待时间会更短。我们通过自动电话服务全天24小时提供信息。（您可以使用我们的自动应答系统告知我们新地址或申请更换医疗保险卡。）如果您失聪或听力困难，您可以拨打我们的TTY号码1-800-325-0778。

我们还希望确保您获得准确且礼貌的服务。因此，我们有第二位社会保障代表监听部分电话。

Once we receive your application, we'll review it. After the review, we will contact you if we need more information or if we need to see your documents.

Once we receive your application, we'll review it. After the review, we will contact you if we need more information or if we need to see your documents.

We'll also let you know if...

- you may be able to receive benefits on another person's record, such as your spouse.

[残疾福利 | 社会保障管理局 > 残疾福利 > 申请后会发生什么？]
在我们收到您的在线申请后，我们将：

- 提供申请确认——无论是电子方式还是邮寄方式。
- 审查申请。
- 如果我们需要更多信息或文件，将通过电话或邮件与您联系。

# 福利规划器：退休 | 家庭福利 | 社会保障管理局

### 家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的款项。这些款项不会减少您的退休福利。实际上，您的家人可能收到的福利价值，加上您自己的，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。实际上，他们可能收到的福利价值，加上您自己的，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额有限制。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家人能收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有符合资格领取福利的离异配偶，这不会影响您或您的家人可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一同申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 配偶福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入医疗保险。

### 我的配偶将获得多少？

如果您的配偶根据自身记录符合福利资格，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，其福利可能受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据自身记录符合资格，其申请将包括两项福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。

# 福利规划器：退休 | 您的家庭福利 | 社会保障管理局

## 福利规划器：退休

### 您的家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的付款。这些付款不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，您的家庭可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，他们可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额是有限制的。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家庭能够收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有一位符合福利资格的前配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一起申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 您的配偶的福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入Medicare。

### 我的配偶将收到多少？

如果您的配偶根据他们自己的记录有资格领取福利，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距离其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄并且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，他们的福利可能会受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据他们自己的记录符合资格，他们的申请将包括两种福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[探索您可能有权获得的福利 > 您或您的家人可能有资格获得增加的福利 > 联系社会保障局]
我们的使命是提供满足公众不断变化需求的社会保障服务。

福利领取者的状况在申请或符合福利资格后发生变化并不罕见。如果您或您的家人领取社会保障或补充保障收入（SSI），某些生活变化可能会影响您获得联邦福利增加的资格。例如，如果您的配偶或前配偶去世，您可能有资格获得更高的社会保障福利。

要了解您或您的家人是否可能基于他人的工作记录而有资格获得福利，或基于您自己的工作记录获得更高的福利，请参阅社会保障网站上的福利信息。您还可以使用福利资格筛选工具（BEST）来了解您是否可以获得社会保障管理局管理的福利。根据您对问题的回答，该工具将列出您可能有资格获得的福利，并告诉您有关如何符合资格和申请的更多信息。

以下问题和答案涉及一些可能增加您福利的生活变化。

您的配偶或前配偶是否已去世？

如果您的配偶或前配偶已去世，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的遗属福利。即使您已经在领取基于另一位配偶的遗属福利，前配偶的去世也可能使您有资格获得更高的遗属福利。

您是否正在领取基于您自己工作记录的医疗保险福利，其中包括至少10年您缴纳社会保障税的收入？

如果您年满65岁，您可能有资格基于自己的记录领取现金福利。如果您已达到完全退休年龄或以上，无论您赚多少钱，您都可以工作并领取每月的社会保障福利。请查阅本出版物以了解更多信息。

您那个曾帮助抚养您的成年子女是否已去世？

如果您的子女有足够的工作积分，并且曾提供您至少一半的生活费，您可能有资格基于他或她的工作记录获得更高的父母福利。

您是否正在领取基于您配偶工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的退休福利。

您是否正在领取基于您父母工作记录的社会保障福利？

如果您工作过，您可能有资格基于自己的工作记录获得更高的残疾福利。

您目前是否未婚，但曾结婚10年或以上？

如果您年满62岁且未婚，并且那段婚姻持续了10年或以上，您可能有资格基于前配偶的工作记录获得福利。

您的子女是否有资格根据您配偶的工作情况领取社会保障子女福利？

如果您照顾的子女未满16岁或在22岁之前残疾，您可能有资格领取配偶福利。

您目前是否正在领取退休或残疾福利，并且照顾的子女未满18岁或残疾？

您的子女可能根据您的工作情况有资格领取福利。

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI）或社会保障福利，并且有服兵役经历？

如果您曾在美国军队服役，您可能有资格通过退伍军人管理局领取福利。请访问此链接了解更多信息：http://www.va.gov/

您是否正在领取补充保障收入（SSI），并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利？

如果您未婚且未满18岁或在22岁之前残疾，并且您的父母一方已故或正在领取社会保障福利，您可能有资格根据您父母的工作情况领取子女福利。

您的收入是否下降或您是否经历了财务资源的损失？

您可能能够通过补充保障收入计划获得额外收入，该计划帮助收入和财务资源有限的老年人和残疾人。

重要提示：如果您正在领取福利，有某些生活事件您必须报告。如需完整列表，请选择下方适用于您所领取福利类型的出版物。

注意：未能报告变更可能导致多付款项。

领取社会保障残疾福利时您需要了解的事项（第11-18页）

我们的网站是了解社会保障局所有计划信息的重要资源。您可以在线办理许多事项。

除了使用我们的网站，您还可以拨打我们的免费电话1-800-772-1213。我们对所有通话保密。我们可以在周一至周五上午7点至下午7点回答具体问题。通常，如果您在周二之后的工作日打电话，等待时间会更短。我们通过自动电话服务全天24小时提供信息。（您可以使用我们的自动应答系统告知我们新地址或申请更换医疗保险卡。）如果您失聪或听力困难，您可以拨打我们的TTY号码1-800-325-0778。

我们还希望确保您获得准确且礼貌的服务。因此，我们有第二位社会保障代表监听部分电话。

Once we receive your application, we'll review it. After the review, we will contact you if we need more information or if we need to see your documents.

We'll also let you know if...

- you may be able to receive benefits on another person's record, such as your spouse.
- other family members may be able to receive benefits on your work record.

When we have all of the necessary information and documents, we'll process your application and send you a letter about our decision in the mail.

# 福利规划器：退休 | 家庭福利 | 社会保障管理局

### 家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的款项。这些款项不会减少您的退休福利。实际上，您的家人可能收到的福利价值，加上您自己的，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。实际上，他们可能收到的福利价值，加上您自己的，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额有限制。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家人能收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有符合资格领取福利的离异配偶，这不会影响您或您的家人可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一同申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 配偶福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入医疗保险。

### 我的配偶将获得多少？

如果您的配偶根据自身记录符合福利资格，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，其福利可能受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据自身记录符合资格，其申请将包括两项福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。

# 福利规划器：退休 | 您的家庭福利 | 社会保障管理局

## 福利规划器：退休

### 您的家庭福利

当您开始领取社会保障退休福利时，您的部分家庭成员也可能有资格根据您的记录领取福利。

如果他们符合资格，您的配偶或子女每月可能收到高达您全额退休福利金额一半的付款。这些付款不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，您的家庭可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

支付给您配偶的福利不会减少您的退休福利。事实上，他们可能获得的福利价值加上您自己的福利，可能有助于您决定提前领取福利是否更有利。

### 最高家庭福利

如果您的子女之一**也符合资格**领取福利，我们能够支付给您家庭的金额是有限制的。总额取决于您的福利金额以及根据您的记录也符合资格的家庭成员人数。

总额各不相同，但通常您和您的家庭能够收到的总金额约为您全额退休福利的150%至180%。

如果您有一位符合福利资格的前配偶，这不会影响您或您的家庭可能收到的福利金额。

如果您的任何合格家庭成员与您一起申请福利，我们将要求您提供他们的社会保障号码和出生证明。

### 您的配偶的福利

即使您的配偶从未在社会保障制度下工作过，只要他们年满62岁，并且您正在领取或有资格领取退休或残疾福利，他们也可能获得福利。您的配偶在65岁时也有资格加入Medicare。

### 我的配偶将收到多少？

如果您的配偶根据他们自己的记录有资格领取福利，我们将首先支付该金额。如果根据您的记录的福利更高，他们将根据您的记录获得额外金额，以便福利组合等于该更高金额。

您配偶的福利不包括您可能获得的任何延迟退休积分。

如果他们开始领取福利：

- 在62岁至其全额退休年龄之间，金额将根据距离其全额退休年龄的月数按百分比永久减少。如果您的配偶未达到全额退休年龄并且：
  - 在领取福利期间工作，他们的福利可能会受到退休收入测试的影响。
  - 也根据他们自己的记录符合资格，他们的申请将包括两种福利。
- 在其全额退休年龄时，配偶的福利不能超过您全额退休金额的一半。

contexts.chunk_id: Conditional and restricted use licenses#3_0::c0000
contexts.text:
# Conditional 和 Restricted Use 许可证

你必须亲自到 DMV 办公室申请 conditional 或 restricted use 许可证。你可以在大多数（但不是所有）Motor Vehicles 办公室办理。请联系离你最近的办公室 [1] 以了解在哪里申请。

### Conditional

DMV 可以向符合条件的驾驶员签发 conditional license，前提是该驾驶员的 NY State 驾照因酒精或毒品相关的违规行为而被吊销或撤销。该驾驶员必须参加由 DMV 批准的 Impaired Driver Program (IDP) [2]（以前称为 Drinking Driving Program (DDP)）。

### Restricted use

DMV 可以向符合条件且其驾照因非酒精或毒品相关的违规或事故，或因某些毒品相关违规而被吊销或撤销的驾驶员签发 restricted use license。

### 来自其他州的驾驶员

如果你持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，并且满足其他要求，你可以获得在 NY State 驾驶的 conditional driving privilege 或 restricted driving privilege。其条件或限制与持有 NY State 驾驶执照的驾驶员相同。

contexts.chunk_id: Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0007
contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 如何检查您的驾照是否被吊销或撤销]
注册MyDMV并使用“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务。

驾驶特权是您在除签发驾驶执照的州以外的其他州驾驶的合法权利。如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，DMV可以撤销您在纽约州的驾驶特权，但您的外州驾照在其他州可能仍然有效。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。如果您需要支付吊销终止费，您可以在线支付。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。 有关更多信息，请参阅关于纽约州驾驶积分系统[11]。 有关更多信息，请参阅毕业驾照法信息[12]。 如果您因未回应纽约市发出的交通罚单（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线认罪或支付罚单[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务可以为您提供有关在哪里回应交通罚单的更多信息。 如果您因未支付纽约市发出的交通罚单罚款（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线支付罚款[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照”服务[2]可以为您提供有关在哪里支付交通罚单的更多信息。 要解除因未支付子女抚养费而导致的吊销，您必须联系当地的子女抚养费执行机构或纽约州临时和残疾援助办公室（OTDA）。OTDA网站[14]上有当地子女抚养费执行机构的列表。 有关清除这些吊销的信息，请联系税务和财政部门，电话518-862-6000，或访问其网站www.tax.ny.gov[15]。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。

contexts.text:
[支付驾驶员民事罚款 > 您必须提供]
您社会安全号码的最后四位数字 您纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片身份证上的DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（参见如何查找驾驶执照上的信息 [5]），或 您的全名、出生日期和性别

如果您的驾驶执照被撤销，支付驾驶员民事罚款并不会恢复您的驾驶特权。您必须向DMV申请并获得批准 [6] 才能恢复您的驾照或驾驶特权，除非您的撤销是由于未投保事故。如果您的撤销是由于未投保事故，您必须联系DMV保险服务局。8

如果您因违反零容忍法律而被暂停驾驶，您必须等到暂停期结束，支付暂停终止费，并持有有效的驾驶执照才能合法驾驶。要检查您是否持有有效的驾驶执照，请创建MyDMV账户 [4] 并使用我们的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”服务。

contexts.chunk_id: Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0000
contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 驾驶特权暂停]
严重交通违规或多次交通违规定罪可能导致您的驾驶执照或纽约州驾驶特权被暂停或吊销。当您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权 1 被暂停或吊销时，在此驾驶属违法行为。

如果您的执照或驾驶特权被暂停或吊销，DMV 将向我们的档案中的地址发送通知（称为命令）。请务必遵循命令上的指示。

暂停意味着您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权将被剥夺一段时间。您可能需要支付暂停终止费 [1]。您的暂停期可以是定期的（有开始和结束日期）或不定期的，后者在您采取所需行动之前不会结束。

contexts.text:
[Pay driver responsibility assessment [1] > How can I check if a suspension has been removed, or get information about the status of my license?]
To check if a suspension has been removed or to get information about the status of your driver license, sign up for a MyDMV [5].

contexts.chunk_id: Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0005
contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销]
如果您收到 DMV 的命令，说明您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销，这意味着您的执照已被取消，您必须在吊销期结束后重新申请新执照。在大多数情况下，在吊销期结束后，您必须首先请求 DMV 的批准 [4]，然后才能获得新执照。您可能需要重新参加笔试和路考，并支付执照重新申请费。如果您有高风险驾驶记录或未能满足 DMV 要求，您的申请可能会被拒绝。在您的执照或驾驶特权恢复之前，您可能还需要支付驾驶员民事罚款 [5]。

contexts.chunk_id: Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0001
contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 定期暂停]
如果您收到，它将告知您暂停期的持续时间。在暂停期结束、支付终止费并重新持有有效驾驶执照之前，您不得驾驶。您可以使用 DMV 的“我的执照、许可证或身份证”[2] 服务来检查您的执照是否有效。

contexts.chunk_id: Lifetime driving records#3_0::c0000
contexts.text:
[终身驾驶记录 > 终身驾驶记录上显示哪些信息？ > 标题1]
“终身”驾驶记录包含DMV目前掌握的有关驾驶员的所有许可证信息。终身驾驶记录将显示DMV仍持有的所有信息，无论《车辆与交通法》中的数据保留要求如何。该记录可能不包含驾驶员最初获得驾驶特权时的信息。

标准驾驶员执照摘要仅包含DMV仍被要求保留的信息。例如，大多数暂停和吊销仅在标准驾驶记录摘要上显示，自暂停或吊销结束之日起4年内。终身驾驶记录将显示超过4年的暂停和吊销。

每份驾驶记录摘要包含多个部分的信息。请参阅终身驾驶记录摘要说明[1]（DS-242.3），了解如何阅读和理解终身驾驶记录摘要的更多信息。

“标题”部分包括个人的适用信息

- 已故
- 姓名
- 邮寄地址（城市、州、邮政编码）
- 邮寄县
- 文件上显示的姓名
- 来自您的纽约州驾驶员执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片ID卡的DMV ID号（客户ID号）
- 出生日期
- 性别
- 身高
- 眼睛颜色
- 状态信息，适用于
  - 临时访客
  - 军人
  - 退伍军人
  - 器官捐献者
- 暂停和吊销摘要
- 限制驾驶特权的限制条件
- 冒险执照凭证

请参阅表格驾驶员执照类别说明[2]（MV-500C），了解驾驶员执照限制的列表和解释。

contexts.chunk_id: Restore license after revocation#1_0::c0005
contexts.text:
[吊销后恢复驾照 [1] > 在线 > 撤销后在线申请新驾照需要什么？]
某些情况需要在您提交批准申请前采取额外行动。如果您在解决以下列出的项目之前提交申请，我们将发送电子邮件告知您需要做什么。我们将延迟处理您的申请，直到这些项目得到处理并通知DMV：

- 如果法院判决包括缓刑期，且条件包括对重新申请驾照/特权的限制，您必须提供：
  - 一份缓刑条件副本，以及由判决您的法院或您需报到的缓刑办公室出具允许申请驾照的信函。信函必须使用法院或缓刑办公室的信头；或

- 如果您的缓刑已终止，您必须提供法院/缓刑部门使用其信头出具的信函，说明缓刑终止日期；或

- 如果您的缓刑条件不包括驾驶限制，您必须提供条件副本。请将此信息邮寄或传真至DIU：

Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option \#5 (电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午)传真 (518) 474-6208

一旦DIU收到可接受的文件，您就可以在线完成恢复申请。
- 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS)网站 www.oasas.ny.gov [3] 查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗提供者。点击右侧顶部框中的“FIND A PROVIDER”链接。点击项目类型：“Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender”以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索批准的提供者。如果您无法访问互联网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗提供者时，请注意提供者必须出现在列表中。除非提供者已获得OASAS批准，否则将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外的服务，提供者必须位于Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA)网站 https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4] 的批准提供者列表中。提供者将需要表格DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。
- 如果您欠任何DMV费用（暂停终止费、民事罚款或Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA)），必须在申请驾照前支付，否则您的申请处理将延迟。有关如何支付DMV费用的信息，请访问我们的网站dmv.ny.gov [5] 并选择标有Tickets, Points and Penalties的主题。
- 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除/移除子女抚养费暂停，除非Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA)指示这样做。一旦OTDA电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。
- 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] 或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。

- 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。

注意：任何额外的驾驶违规定罪或其他添加到您驾驶记录的事件可能使您不符合批准资格或延迟批准过程。

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Conditional and restricted use licenses#3_0::c0000
retrieval_contexts.text:
# Conditional 和 Restricted Use 许可证

你必须亲自到 DMV 办公室申请 conditional 或 restricted use 许可证。你可以在大多数（但不是所有）Motor Vehicles 办公室办理。请联系离你最近的办公室 [1] 以了解在哪里申请。

### Conditional

DMV 可以向符合条件的驾驶员签发 conditional license，前提是该驾驶员的 NY State 驾照因酒精或毒品相关的违规行为而被吊销或撤销。该驾驶员必须参加由 DMV 批准的 Impaired Driver Program (IDP) [2]（以前称为 Drinking Driving Program (DDP)）。

### Restricted use

DMV 可以向符合条件且其驾照因非酒精或毒品相关的违规或事故，或因某些毒品相关违规而被吊销或撤销的驾驶员签发 restricted use license。

### 来自其他州的驾驶员

如果你持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，并且满足其他要求，你可以获得在 NY State 驾驶的 conditional driving privilege 或 restricted driving privilege。其条件或限制与持有 NY State 驾驶执照的驾驶员相同。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 如何检查您的驾照是否被吊销或撤销]
注册MyDMV并使用“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务。

驾驶特权是您在除签发驾驶执照的州以外的其他州驾驶的合法权利。如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，DMV可以撤销您在纽约州的驾驶特权，但您的外州驾照在其他州可能仍然有效。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。如果您需要支付吊销终止费，您可以在线支付。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。 有关更多信息，请参阅关于纽约州驾驶积分系统[11]。 有关更多信息，请参阅毕业驾照法信息[12]。 如果您因未回应纽约市发出的交通罚单（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线认罪或支付罚单[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”[2]服务可以为您提供有关在哪里回应交通罚单的更多信息。 如果您因未支付纽约市发出的交通罚单罚款（罚单上会注明“交通违规局”）而被吊销驾照，您可以在线支付罚款[13]。如果交通罚单是在纽约州其他地区发出的，您必须直接联系当地法院。DMV的“我的驾照”服务[2]可以为您提供有关在哪里支付交通罚单的更多信息。 要解除因未支付子女抚养费而导致的吊销，您必须联系当地的子女抚养费执行机构或纽约州临时和残疾援助办公室（OTDA）。OTDA网站[14]上有当地子女抚养费执行机构的列表。 有关清除这些吊销的信息，请联系税务和财政部门，电话518-862-6000，或访问其网站www.tax.ny.gov[15]。 如果您因保险中断而被吊销驾照，您可以在线提交保险证明[7]。如果车辆未投保且注册仍然有效，您必须将注册和车牌[8]交还给DMV。有关保险中断的更多信息，请参阅[9]。 有关更多信息，请参阅酒精或药物相关违规[10]。

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Pay driver civil penalty#1_0::c0005
retrieval_contexts.text:
[支付驾驶员民事罚款 > 您必须提供]
您社会安全号码的最后四位数字 您纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片身份证上的DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（参见如何查找驾驶执照上的信息 [5]），或 您的全名、出生日期和性别

如果您的驾驶执照被撤销，支付驾驶员民事罚款并不会恢复您的驾驶特权。您必须向DMV申请并获得批准 [6] 才能恢复您的驾照或驾驶特权，除非您的撤销是由于未投保事故。如果您的撤销是由于未投保事故，您必须联系DMV保险服务局。8

如果您因违反零容忍法律而被暂停驾驶，您必须等到暂停期结束，支付暂停终止费，并持有有效的驾驶执照才能合法驾驶。要检查您是否持有有效的驾驶执照，请创建MyDMV账户 [4] 并使用我们的“我的驾照、许可证或身份证”服务。

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Suspensions and revocations#3_0::c0000
retrieval_contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 驾驶特权暂停]
严重交通违规或多次交通违规定罪可能导致您的驾驶执照或纽约州驾驶特权被暂停或吊销。当您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权 1 被暂停或吊销时，在此驾驶属违法行为。

如果您的执照或驾驶特权被暂停或吊销，DMV 将向我们的档案中的地址发送通知（称为命令）。请务必遵循命令上的指示。

暂停意味着您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权将被剥夺一段时间。您可能需要支付暂停终止费 [1]。您的暂停期可以是定期的（有开始和结束日期）或不定期的，后者在您采取所需行动之前不会结束。

retrieval_contexts.text:
[暂停与吊销 > 驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销]
如果您收到 DMV 的命令，说明您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销，这意味着您的执照已被取消，您必须在吊销期结束后重新申请新执照。在大多数情况下，在吊销期结束后，您必须首先请求 DMV 的批准 [4]，然后才能获得新执照。您可能需要重新参加笔试和路考，并支付执照重新申请费。如果您有高风险驾驶记录或未能满足 DMV 要求，您的申请可能会被拒绝。在您的执照或驾驶特权恢复之前，您可能还需要支付驾驶员民事罚款 [5]。

retrieval_contexts.text:

retrieval_contexts.chunk_id: Lifetime driving records#3_0::c0000
retrieval_contexts.text:
[终身驾驶记录 > 终身驾驶记录上显示哪些信息？ > 标题1]
“终身”驾驶记录包含DMV目前掌握的有关驾驶员的所有许可证信息。终身驾驶记录将显示DMV仍持有的所有信息，无论《车辆与交通法》中的数据保留要求如何。该记录可能不包含驾驶员最初获得驾驶特权时的信息。

标准驾驶员执照摘要仅包含DMV仍被要求保留的信息。例如，大多数暂停和吊销仅在标准驾驶记录摘要上显示，自暂停或吊销结束之日起4年内。终身驾驶记录将显示超过4年的暂停和吊销。

每份驾驶记录摘要包含多个部分的信息。请参阅终身驾驶记录摘要说明[1]（DS-242.3），了解如何阅读和理解终身驾驶记录摘要的更多信息。

“标题”部分包括个人的适用信息

- 已故
- 姓名
- 邮寄地址（城市、州、邮政编码）
- 邮寄县
- 文件上显示的姓名
- 来自您的纽约州驾驶员执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片ID卡的DMV ID号（客户ID号）
- 出生日期
- 性别
- 身高
- 眼睛颜色
- 状态信息，适用于
  - 临时访客
  - 军人
  - 退伍军人
  - 器官捐献者
- 暂停和吊销摘要
- 限制驾驶特权的限制条件
- 冒险执照凭证

请参阅表格驾驶员执照类别说明[2]（MV-500C），了解驾驶员执照限制的列表和解释。
